samples: This program downloads web pages, measures how many characters each page contains, and prints the results. Its main entry point fetches three sites in parallel, sorts them from largest to smallest, and then also fetches two more pages concurrently with a 10-second timeout before printing their combined size. It is useful if you want a small example of parallel HTTP fetching and reporting, but it depends on network access and will fail if any request fails or the timed section times out.
